object.attr: stakeholder: a pull that leaves conflict markers in a file is common, and a document that silently disappeared would let checks that skip it look clean. Since 0.2.0. Can't be read now also covers a file that can't be opened or read in full (CF-S13).
object.description: If a data file of a document can't be read, Mellon shall list the document with a load error instead of leaving the document out.
